## Program Pengenalan Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi

Program  pengenalan  ditujukan  bagi  anggota  Dewan Komisaris  dan  Direksi  yang  baru  diangkat  guna  mengetahui kondisi Perseroan secara umum. Program ini dilaksanakan selambat-lambatnya  3  bulan  setelah  pengangkatan. Sementara  itu,  pihak  yang  bertanggung  jawab  atas pelaksanaannya adalah Sekretaris Perusahaan dengan dibantu unit kerja lainnya.

## Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors Orientation Program

The orientation program was aimed at newly appointed members  of  the  Board  of  Commissioners  and  Board of  Directors  to  present  the  general  condition  of  the Company. This program was implemented no later than 3  months after the appointment. Meanwhile, the party responsible  for  its  implementation  was  the  Corporate Secretary and assisted by other work units.

<!-- image -->

Adapun  materi  program  pengenalan  tersebut  secara umum meliputi:

1. Pelaksanaan prinsip-prinsip tata kelola perusahaan yang baik di Perseroan;
2. Gambaran mengenai Perseroan berkaitan dengan tujuan,  sifat,  dan  lingkup  kegiatan,  kinerja  keuangan  dan operasi, strategi, rencana usaha jangka pendek dan jangka panjang, posisi kompetitif, risiko, pengendalian internal, dan masalah-masalah strategis lainnya;
3. Keterangan  berkaitan  dengan  kewenangan  yang didelegasikan, audit internal dan eksternal, sistem dan kebijakan pengendalian internal, serta Komite Audit;
4. Keterangan mengenai kewajiban, tugas, tanggung jawab,  dan  hak-hak  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi, serta hal-hal yang tidak diperbolehkan; dan
5. Pemahaman  terkait dengan prinsip etika dan norma yang berlaku di lingkungan Perseroan serta masyarakat setempat.

Selain  itu,  pelaksanaan  program  pengenalan tersebut dapat berupa presentasi, pertemuan, kunjungan ke fasilitas Perseroan, kunjungan ke kantor-kantor cabang, pengkajian dokumen Perseroan, atau program lainnya  yang  dianggap  sesuai  dengan  kebutuhan. Khusus untuk anggota Dewan Komisaris, dapat menyampaikan  permintaan tertulis kepada Direksi untuk diselenggarakannya program pengenalan bagi  anggota  Dewan  Komisaris  yang  baru  pertama kali  diangkat  dalam  RUPS.  Penyelenggaraan  program ini  wajib  didokumentasikan  dengan  baik,  termasuk pencatatan tingkat kehadiran serta keaktifan anggota Dewan Komisaris dalam mengikuti program tersebut.

Pada  tahun  2022,  pelaksanaan  program  ini  ditujukan bagi Bapak  Iwa Kartiwa Hudaya  selaku Komisaris Independen Perseroan yang baru.

## Penilaian Kinerja Dewan Komisaris, Direksi, dan Organ Pendukung

## Penilaian Kinerja Dewan Komisaris

Kinerja  Dewan  Komisaris  juga  akan  dievaluasi  oleh Pemegang Saham pada saat pelaksanaan RUPS Tahunan. Evaluasi penilaian kinerja Dewan Komisaris dilaksanakan secara mandiri melalui self-assessment dan dilaporkan kepada Pemegang Saham dalam RUPS.  Secara umum, kinerja Dewan Komisaris ditentukan berdasarkan tugas kewajiban yang tercantum dalam peraturan perundangundangan yang berlaku dan Anggaran Dasar Perseroan ataupun amanat Pemegang Saham.

The  material  for  the  orientation  program  in  general includes:

1. Implementation of the principles of good corporate governance in the Company;
2. An overview of the Company in terms of objectives, nature and scope of activities, financial performance and operations, strategy, short and long term business plans, competitiveness, risk, internal control, and other strategic issues;
3. Information related to delegation of authority, internal and external audits, internal control systems and policies, and the Audit Committee;
4. Information on the obligations, duties, responsibilities and  rights  of  the  Board  of  Commissioners  and the  Board  of  Directors,  as  well  as  matters  that  are prohibited; and
5. Comprehension of the ethical principles and norms that apply within the  Company  and  the  local community.

Furthermore,  the  implementation  of  the  orientation program was conducted in the form of presentations, meetings,  visits  to  the  Company's  facilities,  visits  to branch  offices,  review  of  Company  documents,  or other  programs  deemed  appropriate.  Specifically  for members  of  the  Board  of  Commissioners,  they  were allowed  to  submit  a  written  request  to  the  Board  of Directors  to  hold  an  orientation  program  intended for  members  of  the  Board  of  Commissioners  who were  appointed  at  the  GMS  for  the  first  time.  The implementation  of  this  program  must  be  properly documented,  which  includes  the  level  of  attendance record and the engagement of members of the Board of Commissioners who participated in the program.

In 2022, the implementation of this program was aimed at  Mr.  Iwa  Kartiwa  Hudaya  who  was  appointed  as  the new Independent Commissioner of the Company.

## Performance Assessment of the Board of Commissioners, Board of Directors, and Supporting Organs

## Board of Commissioners Performance Assessment

The  performance  of  the  Board  of  Commissioners  was evaluated by the Shareholders at the time of the Annual GMS. Evaluation of the performance assessment of the Board of Commissioners was carried out independently through self-assessment and reported to Shareholders at the GMS. In general, the performance of the Board of Commissioners  was  determined  based  on  the  duties and  obligations  stipulated  in  the  applicable  laws  and regulations and the Company's Articles of Association or through the mandate of the Shareholders.

Sementara itu, hasil penilaian kinerja tahun 2022 menunjukkan bahwa Dewan Komisaris telah melaksanakan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya dengan baik sesuai dengan kriteria penilaian yang ditetapkan. Hal  ini  tercermin  dalam  kualitas  pemberian  saran dan  nasihat  kepada  Direksi  terkait  pengurusan  dan pengelolaan  Perseroan  yang  berdampak  terhadap kinerja Perseroan menjadi lebih baik.

## Penilaian Kinerja Direksi

Kinerja anggota Direksi dievaluasi oleh Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi merujuk pada kriteria yang ditetapkan oleh  Dewan  Komisaris  berdasarkan Key  Performance Indicator (KPI), meliputi:

1. Pencapaian target Perseroan yang tertuang dalam Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Perusahaan (RKAP);
2. Kontribusi dalam aktivitas usaha Perseroan;
3. Komitmen dalam memajukan kepentingan Perseroan;
4. Ketaatan terhadap peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku serta kebijakan Perseroan; dan
5. Tingkat  kehadiran  dalam  rapat  Direksi  maupun rapat-rapat dengan Dewan Komisaris.

Kinerja dari Perseroan merupakan cerminan dari hasil  kinerja  Direksi  secara  keseluruhan.  Hasil  evaluasi kinerja Direksi secara keseluruhan dan kinerja masingmasing  anggota  Direksi  secara  individual  dilaporkan kepada Dewan Komisaris dan merupakan bagian dari yang  tak  terpisahkan  dalam  skema  kompensasi  dan pemberian insentif bagi anggota Direksi. Selain itu, hasil evaluasi  tersebut  juga  merupakan  salah  satu  dasar pertimbangan, khususnya bagi  Pemegang  Saham, untuk  pemberhentian  dan/atau  penunjukan  kembali anggota Direksi yang bersangkutan.

Hasil penilaian kinerja tahun 2022 menunjukkan bahwa Direksi  telah  memenuhi  kriteria  penilaian  yang  telah ditetapkan, baik secara  kolektif  maupun  individual. Hal tersebut tercermin dalam kinerja positif Perseroan, pemenuhan target kerja yang telah dicapai di tahun  2022,  kepatuhan  Perseroan  dalam  peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku, serta tingkat kehadiran dalam rapat internal dan gabungan dengan Dewan Komisaris sebesar 100%.

## Penilaian terhadap Kinerja Organ Pendukung Dewan Komisaris

Perseroan telah membentuk beberapa organ pendukung Dewan Komisaris, yakni Komite Audit, Komite Nominasi  dan  Remunerasi,  Komite  Manajemen  Risiko dan  Investasi,  serta  Komite  Keberlanjutan  Usaha  dan

<!-- image -->

Meanwhile, the results of the 2022 performance assessment showed that the Board of Commissioners had properly carried out its duties and responsibilities following the established assessment criteria. This was reflected  in  the  quality  of  inputs  and  provision  of advice  to  the  Board  of  Directors  on  the  organization and management of the Company, which resulted in a better impact on the Company's performance.

## Board of Directors Performance Assessment

The performance of members of the Board of Directors was  evaluated  by  the  Nomination  and  Remuneration Committee referring to the criteria set by the Board of Commissioners based on the Key Performance Indicator (KPI), including:

1. Achievement of the Company's targets set out in the Company's Work Plan and Budget (RKAP);
2. Contribution to the Company's business activities;
3. Commitment  to  advancing  the  interests  of  the Company;
4. Compliance  with  applicable  laws  and  regulations and the Company's policies; and
5. The level of attendance at the meetings of the Board of  Directors  and  joint  meetings  with  the  Board  of Commissioners.

The  performance  of  the  Company  was  a  reflection  of the overall performance of the Board of Directors. The results  of  the  evaluation  of  the  performance  of  the Board of Directors as a whole and the performance of each member of the Board of Directors individually were reported to the Board of Commissioners and were an integral part of the remuneration and incentive scheme consideration for members of the Board of Directors. In addition, the evaluation results were also became one of the basic considerations, especially for Shareholders, for the dismissal and/or reappointment of the member of the Board of Directors.

The results of the 2022 performance assessment showed  that  the  Board  of Directors  had  met  the established assessment criteria, both collectively and  individually.  This  was  reflected  in  the  Company's positive  performance,  fulfillment  of  work  targets  that were  achieved  in  2022,  the  Company's  compliance with  applicable  laws  and  regulations,  as  well  as  the attendance rate in internal and joint meetings with the Board of Commissioners of 100%.

## Assessment of the Performance of the Supporting Organs of the Board of Commissioners

The Company  has  established several supporting organs under the Board of Commissioners, namely the Audit  Committee,  the  Nomination  and  Remuneration Committee,  the  Risk  Management  and  Investment

<!-- image -->

Tanggung  Jawab  Sosial  Perusahaan,  yang  bertugas untuk  membantu  dan  memberi  saran  dan  masukan, baik kepada Dewan Komisaris ataupun Direksi Perseroan.  Perseroan  juga  telah  membentuk  piagam yang  berisikan  pedoman  dan  alur  proses  kerja  untuk masing-masing  komite,  yaitu  Komite  Audit,  Komite Nominasi  dan  Remunerasi,  Komite  Manajemen  Risiko dan  Investasi,  serta  Komite  Keberlanjutan  Usaha  dan Tanggung Jawab Sosial Perusahaan.

Komite  yang  merupakan  organ  pendukung  Dewan Komisaris  selama  tahun  2022  menunjukkan  bahwa seluruhnya  telah  melaksanakan  tugas  dan  tanggung jawab  dengan  baik  sebagaimana  diamanatkan  oleh Perseroan,  keterlibatan  dalam  rapat,  hasil  rapat,  dan mampu mencapai target yang telah diberikan.

## Penilaian terhadap Kinerja Organ Pendukung Direksi

Perseroan tidak memiliki  komite  yang  mendukung pelaksanaan tugas Direksi. Dengan demikian, informasi terkait penilaian kinerja komite yang mendukung pelaksanaan  tugas  Direksi  tidak  diungkapkan  dalam Laporan Tahunan ini.

## Kebijakan Nominasi dan Remunerasi

## Kebijakan Nominasi

Proses nominasi Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi merupakan bagian tanggung jawab Komite Nominasi dan  Remunerasi.  Alur  proses  nominasi  tersebut,  yakni Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi menyerahkan daftar nama  calon  anggota  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi dalam  pelaksanaan  rapat  internal  Dewan  Komisaris. Calon anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi yang terpilih, kemudian akan diangkat dalam pelaksanaan RUPS.

## Kebijakan Remunerasi

Penyusunan kebijakan remunerasi bagi anggota Dewan Komisaris  dan  Direksi  dilakukan  oleh  Komite  Nominasi dan Remunerasi dengan memperhatikan:

1. Remunerasi yang berlaku pada industri sejenis;
2. Tugas,  tanggung  jawab,  dan  wewenang  anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi yang dikaitkan dengan pencapaian tujuan dan kinerja Perseroan;
3. Target kinerja atau kinerja masing-masing anggota Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi; serta

Committee, as well as the Sustainability and Corporate Social  Responsibility  Committee,  whose  duties  are  to assist and provide advice and input, both to the Board of  Commissioners  and  the  Board  of  Directors  of  the Company. The Company has also established a charter containing  guidelines  and  work  process  flow  for  each committee,  namely  the  Audit  Committee,  Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Risk Management and  Investment  Committee,  and  Sustainability  and Corporate Social Responsibility Committee.

The Committees, which were a supporting organ under the Board of Commissioners during 2022, showed that all of them had carried out their duties and responsibilities properly as mandated by the Company, were involved in meetings, meeting results, and were able to achieve the targets that had been given.

## Assessment of the Performance of the Supporting Organs of the Board of Directors

The company did not have a committee that supports the  implementation  of  the  duties  of  the  Board  of Directors. Thus, information regarding the performance assessment of the committees that support the implementation of the duties of the Board of Directors is not disclosed in this Annual Report.

## Nomination and Remuneration Policy

## Nomination Policy

The nomination process for the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors was part of the responsibility of  the  Nomination  and  Remuneration  Committee.  The nomination process was conducted by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, who submitted a list  of  names  of  prospective  members  of  the  Board of  Commissioners  and  the  Board  of  Directors  in  the implementation  of  the  internal  meeting  of  the  Board of  Commissioners. The elected members of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors were then be appointed in the implementation of the GMS.

## Remuneration Policy

The formulation of remuneration policies for members of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors was carried out by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee by taking into account:

1. Remuneration that applied to similar industries;
2. Duties, responsibilities and authorities of the members of  the  Board  of  Commissioners  and  the Board of Directors related to the achievement of the Company's goals and performance;
3. Performance targets or performance of each member of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors; and

4. Keseimbangan tunjangan antara yang bersifat tetap dan variabel.

Selain hal tersebut, dengan mempertimbangkan rekomendasi  dari  Komite  Nominasi  dan  Remunerasi, Dewan Komisaris menetapkan besaran dan jenis remunerasi  serta  fasilitas  lain  bagi  anggota  Direksi. Adapun untuk penetapan besaran dan jenis remunerasi serta  fasilitas  lain  bagi  Dewan  Komisaris  dilakukan oleh  Pemegang Saham pada saat pelaksanaan RUPS Tahunan.

Besaran  dan  jenis  remunerasi  yang  diberikan  kepada Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi pada tahun 2022 diungkapkan sebagai berikut.

As  for  determination  of  the amount and type of remuneration and other facilities for the Board of Commissioners, this function was carried out by the Shareholders at the time of the Annual GMS.

## Komite Audit

## Audit Committee

Komite Audit  adalah  organ  pendukung  yang  berfungsi membantu Dewan Komisaris dalam melakukan pengawasan terhadap pelaporan keuangan, penerapan sistem pengendalian internal, penerapan sistem manajemen risiko,  penerapan  GCG,  dan  proses  audit. Komite  Audit  juga  turut  memperhatikan  kepatuhan Perseroan terhadap hukum dan peraturan yang berlaku.

## Pedoman Kerja

Perseroan memiliki Piagam Komite Audit yang ditetapkan berdasarkan Surat Keputusan Dewan Komisaris No. 02/SK-DEKOM/TPA/XI/2021 tanggal 29 November 2021 tentang  Pembentukan  Piagam  Komite  Audit.  Piagam tersebut menjadi panduan dalam memahami peraturan terkait  tata  kerja  Komite  Audit,  sehingga  rekomendasi yang  diberikan  kepada  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi sesuai dengan kebutuhan dan tujuan Perseroan.

The Audit Committee is a supporting organ that functions to  assist  the  Board  of  Commissioners  in  supervising financial reporting, implementing internal control systems, implementing risk management  systems, implementing GCG, and auditing processes. The Audit Committee  also  ensures  the  Company's  compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

## Work Guidelines

The Company has an Audit Committee Charter, which  established  based  on  the  Decree  of  the  Board of Commissioners No. 02/SK-DEKOM/TPA/XI/2021 dated  29  November  2021  on  the  Establishment  of the  Audit  Committee  Charter.  The  charter  serves  as a  guide  in  understanding  regulations  related  to  the work  procedures  of  the  Audit  Committee  so  that  the recommendations given to the Board of Commissioners and the Board of Directors are in accordance with the needs and objectives of the Company.

<!-- image -->

## Komposisi dan Independensi

Komite Audit terdiri dari 3 orang, yakni Komisaris Independen sebagai ketua serta 2 orang pihak yang  berasal  dari  luar  Perseroan  sebagai  anggota. Sehubungan  dengan  pengunduran  diri  Bapak  Mirza Adityaswara sebagai Ketua Komite Audit,  susunan anggota Komite Audit Perseroan mengalami perubahan pada tahun 2022, yang mana telah diangkat Bapak Iwa Kartiwa Hudaya sebagai penggantinya.

Pengangkatan anggota Komite Audit telah mempertimbangkan kemampuan, pengetahuan, pengalaman sesuai dengan bidang pekerjaannya, serta mampu  berkomunikasi  dengan  baik.  Selain  itu,  yang bersangkutan juga telah memenuhi kriteria peraturan perundang-undangan  yang  berlaku  dan  memenuhi aspek independensi berikut.

## Composition and Independence

The Audit Committee consisted of 3 personnel, namely an  Independent  Commissioner  as  chairman  and  2 personnel as members from outside the Company. In connection with the resignation of Mr. Mirza Adityaswara as a Chairman of the Audit Committee, the composition of the members of the Company's Audit Committee was changed in 2022, in which Mr. Iwa Kartiwa Hudaya was appointed to fill the position.

The appointment of members of the Audit Committee was  carried  out  by  taking  into  account  the  ability, comprehension, experience following the field of expertise, and excellent communication skills. In addition,  members  of  the  audit  committee  must  also met the criteria of the applicable laws and regulations and fulfilled the following aspects of independence.

Meraih gelar Sarjana Ekonomi dari Universitas Indonesia dan memiliki sertifikasi profesi Certified Management Accountant (CMA)  dari  Institute  of  Certified  Management  Accountant, Australia, Chartered  Accountant (CA)  dari  Ikatan  Akuntan Indonesia, serta Chartered Accountants Worldwide dan Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (LSSGB) dari General Electric.

## Pengalaman Kerja / Work Experience

Memiliki pengalaman lebih dari 20 tahun di bidang keuangan dan audit. Kariernya dimulai di Kantor Akuntan Publik KPMG dan Ernst &amp; Young (1997-2004). Kemudian, menduduki jabatan strategis di  beberapa perusahaan, seperti Direksi &amp; Komisaris WPP Group (2016-2018), Head Finance Herbalife (2014-2016), Head Finance GE Power &amp; Water (2012-2014), serta beberapa posisi  manajerial  dengan  jabatan  terakhir  sebagai Lead Corporate  Audit Medco  Energi  (2006-2012).  Saat  ini,  beliau tidak merangkap jabatan baik di Perseroan dan Entitas Anak ataupun perusahaan publik lain.

## Hubungan Afiliasi / Affiliation Relationship

Tidak  memiliki  hubungan  afiliasi  dengan  anggota  Dewan Komisaris, anggota Direksi, serta Pemegang Saham Pengendali.

Served as a member of the Audit Committee based on the Decree of the Board of Commissioners No. 01/SK-DEKOM/TPA/ XI/2021 dated 29 November 2021 on the Establishment of an Audit Committee with a term of office up to 2024.

Bachelor of Economics from the University of Indonesia and holds a Certified Management Accountant (CMA) professional certification  from  the  Institute  of  Certified  Management Accountant,  Australia,  a  Chartered  Accountant  (CA)  from the Institute of Indonesia Chartered Accountants, as well as Chartered Accountants Worldwide and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (LSSGB) from General Electric.

More than 20 years of experience in finance and auditing. His career began at KPMG and Ernst &amp; Young Public Accounting Firm  (1997-2004).  Then,  held  strategic  positions  in  several companies, such as WPP Group Directors &amp; Commissioners (2016-2018), Herbalife Head Finance (2014-2016), GE Power &amp; Water Head Finance (2012-2014), as well as several managerial positions with last position as Lead Corporate Audit of Medco Energi (2006-2012). He did not hold concurrent positions in the Company and Subsidiaries or other public companies.

Is not affiliated with members of the Board of Commissioners, members of the Board of Directors, and Controlling Shareholders.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

Tugas dan tanggung jawab Komite Audit diungkapkan sebagai berikut.

1. Melakukan  penelaahan  atas  informasi  keuangan yang akan dikeluarkan Perseroan kepada publik dan/ atau pihak otoritas, antara lain Laporan Keuangan, proyeksi, dan laporan lainnya terkait dengan informasi keuangan Perseroan.
2. Melakukan  penelaahan  atas  ketaatan  terhadap peraturan perundang-undangan yang berhubungan dengan kegiatan Perseroan.
3. Memberikan pendapat independen dalam hal terjadi perbedaan pendapat antara manajemen dan akuntan publik atas jasa yang diberikannya.
4. Memberikan  rekomendasi  kepada  Dewan  Komisaris mengenai penunjukan akuntan publik yang didasarkan pada  independensi,  ruang  lingkup  penugasan,  dan imbalan jasa.
5. Melakukan penelaahan atas pelaksanaan pemeriksaan oleh auditor internal dan mengawasi pelaksanaan tidak lanjut oleh Direksi atas temuan auditor internal.
6. Melakukan penelaahan terhadap aktivitas pelaksanaan manajemen risiko yang dilakukan oleh Direksi.
7. Menelaah pengaduan yang berkaitan dengan proses akuntansi dan pelaporan keuangan Perseroan.
8. Menelaah  independensi  dan  objektivitas  akuntan publik.
9. Melakukan penelaahan atas kecukupan pemeriksaan yang dilakukan oleh akuntan publik.
10.  Melakukan pemeriksaan terhadap dugaan adanya kesalahan  dalam  keputusan  rapat  Direksi  atau penyimpangan dalam pelaksanaan hasil keputusan rapat Direksi.
11. Menyampaikan  laporan  hasil  penelaahan  kepada seluruh anggota Dewan Komisaris Perseroan setelah selesainya laporan hasil penelaahan yang dilakukan oleh Komite Audit.
12.  Menelaah  dan  memberikan  saran  kepada  Dewan Komisaris terkait dengan adanya potensi benturan kepentingan Perseroan.
13.  Menjaga kerahasiaan dokumen, data, dan informasi Perseroan.

<!-- image -->

## Duties and Responsibilities

The duties and responsibilities of the Audit Committee are disclosed as follows.

1. Reviewing  the  financial  information  that  must  be submitted  by  the  Company  to  the  public  and/ or authorities, including Financial Statements, projections, and other reports related to the Company's financial information.
2. Reviewing  compliance  with  laws  and  regulations related to the Company's activities.
3. Providing an independent opinion in the event of a difference of opinion between the management and the public accountant for the services they provide.
4. Providing recommendations to the Board of Commissioners  on  the  appointment  of  a  public accountant based on independence, scope of assignment, and remuneration for service rendered.
5. Reviewing  the  implementation  of  audits  by  the internal auditors and overseeing the follow-up implementation  by  the  Board  of  Directors  on  the findings of the internal auditors.
6. Reviewing the implementation of risk management activities carried out by the Board of Directors.
7. Review grievances related to the Company's accounting and financial reporting processes.
8. Examining  the independence  and  objectivity of public accountants.
9. Reviewing  the  adequacy  of  audits  conducted  by public accountants.
10.  Examining allegations of errors in the resolutions of the  Board  of  Directors'  meetings  or  irregularities  in the implementation of the resolutions of the Board of Directors' meetings.
11. Reporting  the  review  result  to  all  members  of  the Company's Board of Commissioners after the completion  of  the  review  result  conducted  by  the Audit Committee.
12.  Reviewing  and  providing  advice  to  the  Board  of Commissioners on the potential conflict of interest of the Company.
13.  Maintaining  the  confidentiality  of  the  Company's documents, data, and information.

## Pelaksanaan Tugas Tahun 2022

Pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Komite Audit di sepanjang tahun 2022 diungkapkan sebagai berikut.

1. Menyusun dan mengusulkan Rencana Kerja Komite Audit tahun buku 2022.
2. Mengawasi  dan  menelaah  penyusunan  Laporan Keuangan Tahun 2021 dan Laporan Keuangan Triwulanan 2022.
3. Memberikan pendapat independen dan profesional kepada Dewan Komisaris, terutama mengenai audit internal ataupun eksternal terkait pelaporan keuangan, serta hal lain yang dilaporkan Direksi kepada Dewan Komisaris.  Pendapat  tersebut  disampaikan  dalam pelaksanaan  rapat  gabungan.  Sepanjang  tahun 2022,  tidak  terdapat  perbedaan  pendapat  antara manajemen dengan audit eksternal.
4. Menelaah pelaksanaan program kerja Unit Audit  Internal, serta  memberikan  masukan  untuk  meningkatkan efisiensi dan efektivitas Unit Audit Internal.
5. Memberikan rekomendasi penunjukan Akuntan Publik Dede Rusli dari Kantor Akuntan Publik Purwantono,  Sungkoro  &amp;  Surja  untuk  periode  2022 dengan  mempertimbangkan  independensi,  ruang lingkup, penugasan, dan fee .
6. Menelaah independensi dan objektivitas, serta kecukupan  pemeriksaan  akuntan  publik  bersama Unit Audit Internal untuk proses audit Laporan Keuangan tahun buku 2022.
7. Menelaah  temuan  audit  internal  serta  memantau tindak lanjut yang dilaksanakan oleh Direksi dan unit di bawahnya. Hasil penelaahan tersebut kemudian disampaikan kepada Dewan Komisaris.
8. Menyampaikan laporan penelaahan, yaitu Laporan Keuangan  tahun  2021,  Laporan  Triwulanan  2022, dan  laporan  internal  lainnya  terkait  pengendalian atau proses audit masing-masing unit kerja kepada anggota Dewan Komisaris.
9. Melakukan identifikasi dan pengawasan mengenai situasi  dan  hubungan  afiliasi  di  dalam  lingkungan Perseroan, serta memberikan saran kepada Dewan Komisaris jika terjadinya potensi benturan kepentingan. Selama  tahun  2022,  tidak  ditemukannya  potensi benturan kepentingan terhadap Dewan Komisaris.
10.  Memantau implementasi sistem manajemen risiko melalui  penyelenggaraan rapat dengan Unit Audit Internal. Informasi yang diperoleh dari rapat tersebut digunakan sebagai pertimbangan penyusunan rencana audit internal di tahun berikutnya.

## Implementation of Duties in 2022

Implementation of duties and responsibilities of the Audit Committee throughout 2022 is disclosed as follows.

1. Prepared and proposed the Audit Committee Work Plan for the 2022 financial year.
2. Supervised and reviewed the preparation of the 2021 Financial Report and 2022 Quarterly Financial Report.
3. Provided independent and professional opinions to the Board of Commissioners, especially on internal and  external  audits  related  to  financial  reporting, as  well  as  other  issues  reported  by  the  Board  of Directors to the Board of Commissioners. This opinion was  conveyed  in  the  implementation  of  the  joint meeting. Throughout 2022, there were no differences of opinion between management and external audit.
4. Reviewed the implementation of the work program of  the  Internal  Audit  Unit,  as  well  as  provided  input to  improve  the  efficiency  and  effectiveness  of  the Internal Audit Unit.
5. Provided recommendations for the appointment of Public Accountant Dede Rusli from the Purwantono, Sungkoro &amp; Surja Public Accounting Firm for the 2022 period by taking into account independence, scope, assignment, and remuneration.
6. Reviewed the independence and objectivity, as well as  the  adequacy  of  public  accountant  audits  with the  Internal  Audit  Unit  for  the  audit  process  of  the Financial Statements for the 2022 financial year.
7. Reviewed  internal  audit  findings  and  monitored follow-up actions carried out by the Board of Directors and units under them. The results of the review were then submitted to the Board of Commissioners.
8. Submitted review reports, namely the 2021 Financial Statements, 2022 Quarterly Reports, and other internal reports related to the control or audit process of each work unit to members of the Board of Commissioners.
9. Identified and supervised the situation and affiliation relationships  within  the  Company,  and  provided advice to the Board of Commissioners in the event of a potential conflict of interest. During 2022, there was no potential conflict of interest with the Board of Commissioners.
10.  Monitored the implementation of the risk management system by holding meetings with the Internal Audit Unit. The information obtained from the meeting was used as a consideration for preparing an internal audit plan for the following year.

## Rapat

Komite  Audit  wajib  menyelenggarakan  rapat  internal paling  kurang  1  kali  dalam  3  bulan.  Rapat  ini  hanya dapat  dilaksanakan  apabila  dihadiri  oleh  lebih  dari  ½ jumlah  anggota.  Sepanjang  tahun  2022,  Komite  Audit telah menyelenggarakan rapat internal sebanyak 4 kali, dengan tingkat kehadiran sebagai berikut.

## Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi

Nomination and Remuneration Committee

Komite  Nominasi  dan  Remunerasi  merupakan  organ pendukung Dewan Komisaris  yang  dibentuk  oleh/dan bertanggung  jawab  kepada  Dewan  Komisaris  dalam membantu  melaksanakan  fungsi  dan  tugas  Dewan Komisaris  terkait  nominasi  dan  remunerasi  terhadap anggota Direksi  dan  anggota  Dewan  Komisaris.    Oleh karena itu, komite ini wajib bertindak secara independen dan bertanggung jawab kepada Dewan Komisaris.

## Pedoman Kerja

Perseroan  memiliki  Pedoman  Komite  Nominasi  dan Remunerasi yang  ditetapkan  berdasarkan  Surat  Keputusan Dewan Komisaris No. 03/SK-DEKOM/TPA/XI/2021 tanggal 29 November 2021 tentang Pembentukan Pedoman Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi. Pedoman tersebut menjadi panduan dalam memahami peraturan terkait tata kerja Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi, sehingga rekomendasi yang  diberikan  kepada  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi sesuai dengan kebutuhan dan tujuan Perseroan.

## Komposisi dan Independensi

Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi Perseroan terdiri dari:

1. Seorang Komisaris Independen yang menjabat sebagai ketua;
2. Seorang Komisaris yang menjabat sebagai anggota; dan
3. Seorang pihak yang menduduki jabatan manajerial di  bawah  Direksi  yang  membidangi  sumber  daya manusia sebagai anggota.

Susunan  anggota  Komite  Nominasi  dan  Remunerasi Perseroan  mengalami  perubahan  pada  tahun  2022, sehubungan  dengan  pengunduran  diri  Bapak  Mirza Adityaswara sebagai ketua Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi dan mengangkat Bapak Iwa Kartiwa Hudaya sebagai penggantinya. Pengangkatan anggota Komite Nominasi  dan  Remunerasi  telah  mempertimbangkan kemampuan, pengetahuan, pengalaman sesuai dengan bidang  pekerjaannya,  serta  mampu  berkomunikasi dengan baik.

The  Nomination  and  Remuneration  Committee  is  a supporting organ of the Board of  Commissioners, which established by/and is responsible to the Board of Commissioners in assisting and carrying out the functions and  duties  of  the  Board  of  Commissioners  on  the nomination and remuneration of members of the Board of Directors and members of the Board of Commissioners. Therefore, this committee must act independently and be responsible to the Board of Commissioners.

## Work Guidelines

The Company  has  Guidelines for the Nomination and  Remuneration  Committee,  which  are  stipulated based  on  the  Decree  of  the  Board  of  Commissioners No. 03/SK-DEKOM/TPA/XI/2021 dated 29 November 2021 on Establishment of Guidelines for the Nomination and Remuneration  Committee.  These  guidelines  serve  to help them in comprehending regulations related to the work procedures of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee so that the recommendations given to the Board of Commissioners and Directors are in accordance with the needs and objectives of the Company.

## Composition and Independence

The Company's Nomination and Remuneration Committee consists of:

1. An Independent Commissioner who serves as chairman;
2. A Commissioner who serves as a member; and
3. A  party  holding  a  managerial  position  under  the Board of Directors in charge of human resources as a member.

The  composition  of  the  members  of  the  Nomination and  Remuneration  Committee  of  the  Company  was changed in 2022, in connection with the resignation of Mr.  Mirza  Adityaswara  as  chairman  of  the  Nomination and  Remuneration  Committee  and  appointed  Mr.  Iwa Kartiwa Hudaya as his replacement. The appointment of  members  of  the  Nomination  and  Remuneration Committee was taking into account the ability, knowledge,  experience  following  the  field  of  expertise, and excellent communication skill.

Selain  itu,  Perseroan  menjamin  independensi  seluruh anggota  Komite  Nominasi  dan  Remunerasi  dalam menjalankan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya. Anggota Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi senantiasa bertindak secara profesional demi kepentingan Perseroan tanpa adanya intervensi dari pihak mana pun.

## Profil Komite Nominasi dan Remunerasi

<!-- image -->

In  addition,  the  Company  ensured  the  independence of  all  members  of  the  Nomination  and  Remuneration Committee in carrying out their duties and responsibilities. Members of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee were committed in carrying out  their  duties  professionally  in  the  interest  of  the Company without any intervention from any party.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

Tugas  dan  tanggung  jawab  Komite  Nominasi  dan Remunerasi diungkapkan sebagai berikut.

## 1. Terkait Fungsi Nominasi

- a. Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai:
- 1) Komposisi jabatan anggota Dewan Komisaris dan/atau anggota Direksi;
- 2)  Kebijakan dan kriteria yang dibutuhkan dalam proses nominasi; serta
- 3)  Kebijakan evaluasi kinerja bagi anggota Dewan Komisaris dan/atau anggota Direksi.
- b.  Membantu Dewan Komisaris melakukan penilaian kinerja anggota Dewan Komisaris dan/ atau  anggota  Direksi  berdasarkan  tolok  ukur yang telah disusun sebagai bahan evaluasi.
- c. Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris  mengenai  program  pengembangan kemampuan  anggota  Dewan  Komisaris  dan/ atau anggota Direksi.
- d. Memberikan usulan calon yang memenuhi syarat sebagai anggota Dewan Komisaris dan/ atau  anggota  Direksi  kepada  Dewan  Komisaris untuk disampaikan di dalam RUPS.

## 2. Terkait Fungsi Remunerasi

- a. Memberikan rekomendasi kepada Dewan Komisaris mengenai:
- 1) Struktur remunerasi;
- 2)  Kebijakan atas remunerasi; dan
- 3)  Besaran atas remunerasi.
- b.  Membantu Dewan Komisaris melakukan penilaian kinerja dengan kesesuaian remunerasi yang diterima masing-masing anggota Dewan Komisaris dan/atau anggota Direksi.

## Pelaksanaan Tugas Tahun 2022

Pelaksanaan tugas dan tanggung jawab Komite Nominasi  dan  Remunerasi  di  sepanjang  tahun  2022 diungkapkan sebagai berikut.

1. Memberikan rekomendasi terkait penetapan dan  pengangkatan  Komisaris  Independen  yang menjabat setelah pelaksanaan RUPS Tahunan pada tanggal 27 Mei 2022.
2. Membantu  pelaksanaan  evaluasi  kinerja  anggota Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi  sesuai  dengan  tolok ukur yang telah ditentukan.

## Duties and Responsibilities

The  duties  and  responsibilities  of  the  Nomination  and Remuneration Committee are disclosed as follows.

## 1. On the Nomination Function

- a. Providing  recommendations  to  the  Board  of Commissioners on:
- 1) The composition of the positions of members of the Board of Commissioners and/or members of the Board of Directors;
- 2)  Policies and criteria needed in the nomination process; and
- 3)  Performance evaluation policy for members of the Board of Commissioners and/or members of the Board of Directors.
- b. Assisting the Board of Commissioners in evaluating the performance of members of the Board of Commissioners and/or members of the Board  of  Directors  based  on  benchmarks  that have been prepared as evaluation material.
- c. Providing  recommendations  to  the  Board  of Commissioners  on  competence  development programs for members of the Board of Commissioners and/or members of the Board of Directors.
- d. Providing  proposals  for  candidates  who  meet the  requirements  as  members  of  the  Board  of Commissioners  and/or  members  of  the  Board of Directors to the Board of Commissioners to be submitted at the GMS.

## 2. On the Remuneration Function

- a. Providing  recommendations  to  the  Board  of Commissioners regarding:
- 1) Remuneration structure;
- 2)  Policy on remuneration; and
- 3)  Amount of remuneration.
- b. Assisting the Board of Commissioners in evaluating performance according to the remuneration received by each member of the Board of Commissioners and/or members of the Board of Directors.

## Implementation of Duties in 2022

The  implementation  of  the  duties  and  responsibilities of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee throughout 2022 is disclosed as follows.

1. Provided  recommendations  on  the  determination and  appointment  of  Independent  Commissioners who were in office after the implementation of the Annual GMS on 27 May 2022.
2. Assisted the performance evaluation of members of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors according to predetermined benchmarks.

## Komite Manajemen Risiko dan Investasi

Risk Management and Investment Committee

Komite  Manajemen  Risiko  dan  Investasi  merupakan organ  pendukung  yang  membantu  Dewan  Komisaris dalam menjalankan fungsi pengawasan terhadap pengelolaan  manajemen  risiko  dan  investasi,  agar berjalan  dengan  efisien  dan  efektif  sesuai  dengan prinsip-prinsip GCG.

The  Risk  Management  and  Investment  Committee is a supporting organ that assists the Board of Commissioners in carrying out the supervisory function of  risk  management and investment management so that it runs efficiently and effectively in accordance with GCG principles.

<!-- image -->

## Pedoman Kerja

Perseroan  memiliki  Piagam  Komite  Manajemen  Risiko dan Investasi yang ditetapkan berdasarkan Surat Keputusan  Dewan  Komisaris  No.  04/SK-DEKOM/TPA/I/2022 tanggal 28 Januari 2022 tentang Pembentukan Piagam Komite Manajemen Risiko dan Investasi. Piagam tersebut menjadi panduan dalam memahami peraturan terkait tata  kerja  Komite  Manajemen  Risiko  dan  Investasi, sehingga rekomendasi yang diberikan kepada Dewan Komisaris  dan  Direksi  sesuai  dengan  kebutuhan  dan tujuan Perseroan.

## Komposisi dan Independensi

Komite Manajemen  Risiko dan Investasi Perseroan mempunyai 3 orang anggota yang terdiri dari 1 ketua dan 2 anggota. Pengangkatan anggota Komite Manajemen Risiko dan Investasi telah mempertimbangkan kemampuan, pengetahuan, pengalaman sesuai dengan bidang  pekerjaannya,  serta  mampu  berkomunikasi dengan baik.

Selain  itu,  Perseroan  menjamin  independensi  seluruh anggota Komite Manajemen Risiko dan Investasi dalam menjalankan tugas dan tanggung jawabnya. Anggota Komite  Manajemen  Risiko  dan  Investasi  senantiasa bertindak secara profesional demi kepentingan Perseroan tanpa adanya intervensi dari pihak mana pun.

## Profil Komite Manajemen Risiko dan Investasi

## Work Guidelines

The Company has a Risk Management and Investment Committee Charter, which was stipulated based on the Decree of the Board of Commissioners No.  04/SK-DEKOM/TPA/I/2022  dated  28  January  2022 on  the  Establishment  of  the  Risk  Management  and Investment  Committee  Charter.  The  charter  serves as  a  guideline  in  comprehending  regulations  related to  the  work  procedures  of  the  Risk  Management  and Investment  Committee,  so  that  the  recommendations given  to  the  Board  of  Commissioners  and  the  Board of  Directors  are  in  accordance  with  the  needs  and objectives of the Company.

## Composition and Independence

The  Company's  Risk  Management  and  Investment Committee  has  3  members  consisting  of  1  chairman and 2 members. The appointment of members of the Risk  Management  and  Investment  Committee  was carried out by taking into account the ability, knowledge, experience following the field of expertise, and excellent communication skills.

In  addition,  the  Company  ensured  the  independence of all members of the Risk Management and Investment Committee in carrying out their duties and responsibilities. Members of the Risk Management and Investment Committee were committed in carrying out their duties professionally in the interest of the Company without any intervention from any party.

## Tugas dan Tanggung Jawab

Tugas dan tanggung jawab Komite Manajemen Risiko dan Investasi diungkapkan sebagai berikut.

1. Membantu Dewan Komisaris mengevaluasi sistem manajemen risiko Perseroan, termasuk sistem pengendalian  internal  dan  menilai  toleransi  risiko Perseroan.
2. Membantu  Dewan  Komisaris  dalam  memberikan pendapat profesional dan independen guna diterapkannya Manajemen Risiko Perusahaan ( Enterprise  Risk  Management )  terhadap  aktivitas pelaksanaan manajemen risiko dan kebijakan investasi yang telah ditetapkan dan dijalankan oleh Perseroan.
3. Membantu  menelaah  dan  mengevaluasi  sistem manajemen risiko, kebijakan investasi, pengendalian internal, dan menilai toleransi risiko investasi Perseroan.
4. Membantu  Dewan  Komisaris  dalam  memberikan panduan dan saran kepada Direksi tentang praktik umum pelaksanaan manajemen risiko dan investasi secara keseluruhan di Perseroan dan Entitas Anak.

## Pelaksanaan Tugas Tahun 2022

Terkait  pelaksanaan  tugas  dan  tanggung  jawabnya, Komite Manajemen Risiko dan Investasi telah:

1. Berkomunikasi,  bekerja  sama,  dan  berkoordinasi dengan  Unit  Audit  Internal  dan  unit  kerja  lainnya yang  terkait  dalam  melakukan  penelaahan  dan mengevaluasi manajemen risiko, kebijakan investasi, pengendalian  internal,  dan  menilai  toleransi  risiko investasi;
2. Meminta  bantuan  kepada  pihak  eksternal,  atas persetujuan Dewan Komisaris, untuk melakukan audit khusus dalam hal manajemen risiko dan investasi;
3. Melakukan kajian serta penelahaan atas penerapan sistem  manajemen  risiko,  pengendalian  internal, dan toleransi risiko investasi Perseroan; dan
4. Membantu dan memberikan saran kepada Dewan Komisaris  dalam  rangka  rencana  investasi  dan pengembangan bisnis Perseroan.

<!-- image -->

## Duties and Responsibilities

The duties and responsibilities of the Risk Management and Investment Committee are disclosed as follows.

1. Assisting the Board of Commissioners in evaluating the Company's risk management system, including the internal control system and assessing the Company's risk tolerance.
2. Assisting  the  Board  of  Commissioners  in  providing professional and independent opinions for the implementation of Enterprise  Risk  Management  on risk  management  implementation  activities  and investment policies that have been established and carried out by the Company.
3. Assisting in reviewing and evaluating risk management systems, investment policies, internal controls, and assessing the Company's investment risk tolerance.
4. Assisting  the  Board  of  Commissioners  in  providing guidance  and  advice  to  the  Board  of  Directors on  general  practices  of  risk  management  and investment  as  a  whole  in  the  Company  and  its Subsidiaries.

## Implementation of Duties in 2022

The  following  is  the  implementation  of  the  duties  and responsibilities of the Risk Management and Investment Committee:

1. Communicated, cooperated, and coordinated with the Internal Audit Unit and other related work units in reviewing and evaluating risk  management, investment policies, internal controls, and assessing investment risk tolerance;
2. Requested assistance from external parties, with the approval of the Board of Commissioners, to conduct a  special  audit  in  terms  of  risk  management  and investment;
3. Reviewed and examined the implementation of the risk  management system, internal control, and the Company's investment risk tolerance; dan
4. Assisted and  provided  advice  to the Board  of Commissioners in the framework of the Company's investment and business development plans.

## Duties and Responsibilities

The duties and responsibilities of the Sustainability and Corporate Social Responsibility Committee are disclosed as follows.

1. Providing recommendations to the Board of Commissioners for the development and implementation of social responsibility and plans in terms of developing the sustainability and business continuity of the Company and Subsidiaries.
2. Supporting  the  supervisory  function  of  the  Board of  Commissioners  by  monitoring  the  development and  implementation  of  sustainability  and  social responsibility  program  plans  in  the  Company  and Subsidiaries.
3. Monitoring and ensuring the implementation of general practices for the development of sustainability  and  business  continuity  and  social responsibility in the Company and its Subsidiaries are carried out following the provisions of the applicable laws and regulations.

4. Membantu  Dewan  Komisaris  dalam  memastikan aspek-aspek terkait environment, social, and governance (ESG)  dan  keberlanjutan  usaha  dari kegiatan  operasional  Perseroan  dan  Entitas  Anak diidentifikasi, didokumentasikan, dan dievaluasi secara akurat dan berkala.
5. Membantu  Dewan  Komisaris  untuk  melaksanakan fungsi  pengawasan,  pengembangan,  saran  dan arahan kepada Direksi Perseroan mengenai aspek terkait  ESG  dan  keberlanjutan  usaha  dan  program tanggung jawab sosial Perseroan.
6. Membantu Direksi dalam mengembangkan kemampuan manajemen dan karyawan Perseroan dalam  hal  aspek-aspek  terkait  ESG,  keberlanjutan usaha, dan program tanggung jawab sosial.

## Pelaksanaan Tugas Tahun 2022

Terkait  pelaksanaan  tugas  dan  tanggung  jawabnya, Komite  Keberlanjutan  Usaha  dan  Tanggung  Jawab Sosial Perusahaan telah:

1. Berkomunikasi,  bekerja  sama,  dan  berkoordinasi dengan  semua  unit  kerja  dalam  rangka  meminta informasi,  klarifikasi  dan  berkas-berkas  atau  laporanlaporan  yang  dirasa  terkait  dalam  pelaksanaan kelestarian dan keberlanjutan usaha serta tanggung jawab sosial perusahaan;
2. Meminta  bantuan  kepada  pihak  eksternal,  atas persetujuan  Dewan  Komisaris,  untuk  melakukan audit  khusus  dalam  hal  pengawasan  kelestarian dan  keberlanjutan  serta  tanggung  jawab  sosial perusahaan;
3. Melakukan  pengawasan  atas  proses  digitalisasi Perseroan dengan memberikan masukan dan saran untuk penyempurnaan platform Teladan Green  Metrics (TGM)  dan  pembentukan Teladan Productivity Techology Science (TPTS); dan
4. Memberikan  masukan,  saran,  dan  inisiatif  kepada Manajemen Perseroan    dalam  menjalankan  bisnis yang berkelanjutan, agar dapat menghasilkan dampak yang positif bagi seluruh pemangku kepentingan dan lingkungan.
4. Assisting  the  Board  of  Commissioners  in  ensuring aspects related to environment, social, and governance (ESG) and business sustainability from  the  operational  activities  of  the  Company and  Subsidiaries  are  identified,  documented,  and evaluated accurately and periodically.
5. Assisting the Board of Commissioners in carrying out the  functions  of  supervision,  development,  advice and direction to the Company's Directors on aspects related  to  ESG  and  business  sustainability  and  the Company's social responsibility programs.
6. Assisting  the  Board  of  Directors  in  developing  the capabilities  of  the  Company's  management  and employees in terms of aspects related to ESG, business sustainability and social responsibility programs.

## Implementation of Duties in 2022

The  following  is  implementation  of  the  duties  and responsibilities of the Sustainability and  Corporate Social Responsibility Committee:

## Audit Internal Internal Audit

Audit Internal merupakan  organ pendukung yang membantu  Direksi dalam melakukan pemeriksaan dan  penilaian  atas  pengendalian  internal  di  seluruh unit  kerja  Perseroan.  Oleh  karena  itu,  Audit  Internal dituntut  untuk  memiliki  integritas  dan  perilaku  yang profesional, independen, jujur, dan objektif dalam menjalankan tugasnya.

## Pedoman Kerja

Perseroan  memiliki  Piagam  Unit  Audit  Internal  yang ditetapkan berdasarkan Surat Keputusan Direksi No.  03/SK-DIR/TPA/I/2021  tanggal  29  November  2021. Piagam ini disusun dengan mengacu pada Peraturan Otoritas  Jasa  Keuangan  No.  56/POJK.04/2015  tentang Pembentukan dan Pedoman Penyusunan Piagam Unit Audit Internal.

## Struktur dan Kedudukan

Unit  Audit  Internal  Perseroan  dibentuk  berdasarkan Surat  Keputusan  Direksi  PT  Teladan  Prima  Agro  Tbk No.  02/SK-DIR/TPA/XI/2021  tanggal  29  November  2021 tentang  Pembentukan  Unit  Audit  Internal.  Unit  Audit Internal  dipimpin  oleh  Kepala  Unit  Audit  Internal  yang bertanggung jawab langsung kepada Direktur Utama. Hal ini dikarenakan Kepala Unit Audit Internal diangkat dan diberhentikan oleh Direktur Utama atas persetujuan Dewan Komisaris. Direktur Utama dapat memberhentikan Kepala Unit Audit Internal setelah mendapat persetujuan Dewan Komisaris, jika yang bersangkutan tidak memenuhi  persyaratan  sebagai  auditor  di  Unit  Audit Internal, sebagaimana diatur dalam Peraturan Otoritas Jasa  Keuangan  No.  56/POJK.04/2015  dan/atau  gagal atau tidak cakap dalam menjalankan tugas.

## Profil Kepala Unit Audit Internal

Profil Kepala Unit Audit Internal diungkapkan sebagai berikut.

Internal Audit is a supporting organ that assists the Board of Directors in conducting inspections and assessments of  internal  control  in  all  work  units  of  the  Company. Therefore,  Internal  Audit  is  required  to  have  integrity and  behave  professionally,  independently,  fairly,  and objectively in carrying out its duties.

## Work Guidelines

The Company has an Internal Audit Unit Charter, which is stipulated based  on  Board of Directors Decree No. 03/SK-DIR/TPA/I/2021 dated 29 November 2021. This Charter was  prepared with reference to Financial Services  Authority  Regulation  No.  56/POJK.04/2015  on the Formation and Guidelines for the Preparation of the Internal Audit Unit Charter.

## Structure and Position

The Company's Internal Audit Unit was formed based on the Decree of the Board of Directors of PT Teladan Prima Agro Tbk No. 02/SK-DIR/TPA/XI/2021 dated 29 November 2021 on the Establishment of the Internal Audit Unit. The Internal Audit Unit is led by the Head of the Internal Audit Unit who answers directly to the President Director. This is due to the Head of the Internal Audit Unit is appointed and dismissed by the President Director with the approval of the Board of Commissioners. The President Director can dismiss the Head of the Internal Audit Unit after obtaining approval from the Board of Commissioners should they are no longer meet the requirements as an auditor in the Internal Audit Unit, as stipulated in Financial Services Authority Regulation No. 56/POJK.04/2015 and/or fail or are incompetent in carrying out their duties.

## Sistem Pengendalian Internal

## Internal Control System

Sistem pengendalian internal merupakan sistem yang dirancang  untuk  mengawasi  seluruh  kegiatan  operasional dan  keuangan,  termasuk  dalam  mengamankan  aset yang dimiliki, serta kepatuhan setiap unit kerja terhadap kebijakan  perusahaan  dan  peraturan  yang  berlaku. Terkait hal ini, Perseroan telah memiliki alur dan prosedur kerja sesuai dengan bidang dan divisi masing-masing. Ruang lingkup pengendalian internal tersebut, meliputi aspek  akuntansi  dan  keuangan,  legal,  risiko,  sumber daya manusia, dan operasional.

The  internal  control  system  is  a  system  designed  to oversee all operational and financial activities, including securing  owned  assets,  as  well  as  the  compliance  of each work unit with  company policies and applicable regulations.  Therefore,  the  Company  has  workflows and  procedures  in  accordance  with  their  respective fields and divisions. The scope of internal control system includes  accounting  and  financial,  legal,  risk,  human resources and operational aspects.

## Evaluasi Efektivitas Sistem Pengendalian Internal

Evaluasi efektivitas sistem pengendalian internal dilakukan terhadap rancangan dan pelaksanaan pengendalian. Pelaksanaan evaluasi operasional dilakukan  secara  rutin  oleh  Audit  Internal  di  masingmasing unit kerja. Hasil pemeriksaan tersebut selanjutnya  disampaikan  kepada  Direktur  Utama  dan Komisaris Utama untuk ditindaklanjuti.

## Pernyataan Dewan Komisaris dan Direksi atas Kecukupan Sistem Pengendalian Internal

Pada  tahun  2022,  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi  telah melakukan penilaian terhadap penerapan sistem pengendalian  internal.  Dewan  Komisaris  dan  Direksi memandang bahwa penerapan sistem tersebut cukup  efektif  dalam  mengawasi  aktivitas  operasional, keuangan, dan tata kelola yang sesuai dengan peraturan  perundang-undangan  yang  berlaku.  Akan tetapi,  penyempurnaan terhadap pelaksanaan sistem tersebut  masih  tetap  dibutuhkan  guna  meningkatkan pengendalian  internal  Perseroan  pada  tahun-tahun selanjutnya.

## Manajemen Risiko

Risk Management

Aktivitas bisnis Perseroan menghadapi berbagai risiko yang perlu dikelola dengan baik untuk mencegah terhambatnya capaian sasaran dan target operasional.  Oleh karena itu,  Perseroan  berupaya  untuk  menerapkan  sistem manajemen risiko secara tepat dan dengan didasari prinsip kehati-hatian. Selain berlandaskan peraturan perundangundangan yang berlaku, penerapan manajemen risiko juga menggunakan standar ISO 31000:2018.

Implementasi manajemen risiko melibatkan semua unit kerja,  (divisi,  departemen, estate ,  mill,  dan  pemilik  proyek) untuk  melakukan  identifikasi,  analisis,  menyusun  profil risiko,  mitigasi,  dan  mengelola  risiko  masing-masing. Untuk tingkat manajemen tertinggi dari Perseroan, risiko korporasi yang menjadi tanggung jawab Direksi sebagai risk owner dianalisa oleh Departemen Risk &amp; Compliance selaku risk officer ,  terutama terkait dengan risiko-risiko strategis, seperti dalam hal strategi ekspansi usaha dan langkah strategis Perseroan lainnya.

<!-- image -->

## Evaluation of the Effectiveness of the Internal Control System

Evaluation  of  the  effectiveness  of  the  internal  control system is carried out on the design and implementation of the control system. Operational evaluation is carried out  consistently  by  Internal  Audit  in  each  work  unit. The results of the evaluation are then submitted to the President  Director  and  President  Commissioner  to  be followed up.

## Statement of the Board of Commissioners and Board of Directors on the Adequacy of the Internal Control System

In  2022,  the  Board  of  Commissioners  and  Board  of Directors have conducted an assessment on the implementation  of  the  internal  control  system.  The Board  of  Commissioners  and  Board  of  Directors  view that the implementation of the system is quite effective in  overseeing  operational,  financial  and  governance activities in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations. However, improvements for the implementation  of  the  system  are  still  needed  to improve the Company's internal control in the following years.

The Company's business activities face various risks that need to be managed properly to prevent obstruction in operational goals and targets. Therefore, the Company seeks to implement a risk management system appropriately, based on the principle of prudence. The implementation of risk management is not only based on the applicable laws and regulations, but also the ISO 31000:2018 standard.

The implementation of risk management  involves all  work  units  (divisions,  departments,  estates,  mills and  project  owners)  to  identify,  analyze,  develop  risk profiles,  mitigate  and  manage  their  respective  risks. For  the  highest  management  level  of  the  Company, the  corporate  risk  is  the  responsibility  of  the  Board  of Directors  as  the  risk  owner  is  analyzed  by  the  Risk  &amp; Compliance  Department  as  the  risk  officer,  especially related to strategic risks, such as in terms of business expansion strategy and other company strategic steps.

<!-- image -->

Untuk tingkat manajerial dan unit bisnis risiko yang ada pada  level  tersebut,  akan  menjadi  tanggung  jawab Head dari unit risk owner . Risiko ini akan dikoordinasikan oleh Departemen Risk &amp; Compliance dengan risk officer yang ada di masing-masing unit, meliputi identifikasi, mitigasi,  dan risk  officer yang  ada  di  masing-masing unit, meliputi identifikasi, mitigasi, dan risk appetite atau residual risk sesuai dengan arahan Direksi.

Perseroan senantiasa mengoptimalkan penerapan manajemen risiko sehingga menjadi bagian integral dari GCG Perseroan, seperti penerapan model pertahanan 3 lapis ( 3 lines of defense /3LD) meliputi:

1. Pertahanan lapis pertama dilaksanakan oleh unit  atau  fungsi  bisnis  yang  melakukan  aktivitas operasional  perusahaan  sehari-hari,  yaitu  dengan lingkungan pengendalian ( control environment ) yang kondusif, menerapkan kebijakan manajemen risiko, mempertimbangkan faktor risiko dalam setiap keputusan,  serta  memiliki  pengendalian  internal yang efektif;
2. Pertahanan lapis kedua dilaksanakan oleh Departemen Corporate  Risk  &amp;  Compliance ,  yang  bertanggung jawab  untuk  mengembangkan  dan  memantau implementasi manajemen risiko Perseroan, melakukan pengawasan pelaksanaan fungsi bisnis dalam koridor  kebijakan  manajemen  risiko,  memantau dan    melaporkan  risiko-risiko  Perseroan  kepada pemegang akuntabilitas tertinggi di Perseroan; dan
3. Pertahanan lapis ketiga dilaksanakan oleh auditor, baik auditor internal  maupun  auditor  eksternal. Peran auditor internal jauh lebih intens dalam model 3LD  ini.    Perannya  meliputi  melakukan    kajian  dan evaluasi  terhadap  rancang  bangun,  implementasi manajemen risiko, dan memastikan bahwa pertahanan lapis pertama dan lapis kedua berjalan sesuai dengan yang diharapkan.

Penerapan  model  3LD  ini  diyakini  akan  memperkuat daya tahan ( resilience ) Perseroan terhadap risiko-risiko yang dihadapi. Kematangan dan efektivitas penerapan Enterprise  Risk  Management (ERM)  di  Perseroan  akan tercermin dari efektivitas penerapan model 3LD ini.

For managerial levels and risk business units at that level, it will be the responsibility of the Head of the risk owner unit. This risk will be coordinated by the Risk &amp; Compliance Department with the risk officers in each unit, covering identification,  mitigation  and  risk  officers  in  each  unit, including identification,  mitigation  and risk  appetite  or residual risk in accordance with the directives Board of Directors.

The Company always optimizes the implementation of risk management so that it becomes an integral part of the Company's GCG, such as implementing the 3 lines of defense (3LD) model including:

1. The  first  line  of  defense  is  carried  out  by  business units  or  functions  that  carry  out  the  company's daily operational activities, namely with a conducive  control  environment,  implementing  risk management  policies,  considering  risk  factors  in every decision, and having effective internal controls;
2. The  second  line  of  defense  is  carried  out  by  the Corporate  Risk  &amp;  Compliance  Department,  which is  responsible  for  developing  and  monitoring  the implementation of the Company's risk management, overseeing the implementation of business functions in the corridor of risk management policies, monitoring and reporting the Company's risks to the highest accountability holder in the Company; and
3. The third line of defense is carried out by auditors, both  internal  auditors  and  external  auditors.  The role  of  internal  auditors  is  more  intense  in  this  3LD model. This role includes reviewing and evaluating the  design,  implementing  risk  management,  and ensuring  that  the  first  and  second  line  of  defense work as expected.

The application of the 3LD model is believed to strengthen the Company's resilience to potential risks. The maturity and effectiveness of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) implementation in the Company will be reflected in the effectiveness of implementing this 3LD model.

Sementara  itu,  Direksi  dengan  akuntabilitas  eksekutif memiliki  kontrol  langsung  terhadap  3LD,  sedangkan Komisaris  dengan  akuntabilitas  pengawasan  memiliki mekanisme  pengawasan  melalui  Komite  Audit  serta Komite Manajemen Risiko dan Investasi terhadap pertahanan  lapis  kedua  dan  pertahanan  lapis  ketiga seperti dalam gambar berikut.

<!-- image -->

Meanwhile, the Board of Directors with executive accountability  have  direct  control  over  3LD,  while  the Board of Commissioners with supervisory accountability have oversight mechanisms through the Audit Committee and the Risk and Investment Management Committee on the second line of defense and third line of defense as shown in the following figure.

| ## Jenis Risiko Risk Type  Mitigasi  Mitigation  Risiko perubahan kebijakan  pajak ekspor  crude palm oil  (CPO) dan kebijakan impor.  Risk of changes in crude palm  oil (CPO) export tax policies and  import policies.  Kebijakan  pajak  ekspor  CPO  ditetapkan  berdasarkan  perkembangan  harga  CPO.  Dengan  adanya peningkatan harga CPO yang cukup signifikan dan kelangkaan minyak di pasar dalam  negeri, membuat Pemerintah Republik Indonesia menerapkan larangan ekspor CPO dan produk  turunannya pada pertengahan tahun 2022. Saat ini, pajak ekspor CPO ditetapkan sesuai dengan  Peraturan Menteri Keuangan (PMK) No. 115/2022 tentang Perubahan atas PMK No. 103/2022 tentang  Tarif Layanan Badan Layanan Umum BPDPKS pada Kementerian Keuangan yang ditetapkan dan  diundangkan pada 15 Juli 2022. Dengan berlakunya peraturan ini, maka diterapkan insentif berupa  penghapusan  sementara  pungutan  ekspor  (PE)  minyak  sawit  mentah  CPO  dan  turunannya  yang dikelola oleh Badan Pengelola Dana Pungutan Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit (BPDPKS) sampai  dengan  akhir  Desember  2022.  Insentif  ini  akan  berlaku  apabila  harga  sawit  masih  berada  di  bawah  USD800,-  per  MT,  dan  apabila  harga  naik  di  atas  tersebut,  maka  akan  diberlakukan  PE  sebagaimana  normal  diatur  pada  PMK.  Pengenaan  pajak  ekspor  CPO  dapat  mengurangi  pendapatan, namun pengenaan dilakukan pada harga CPO yang relatif tinggi dan apabila harga  turun maka pengenaan tidak dikenakan, sehingga tidak terlalu mengganggu keuangan Perseroan.  Namun demikian, tidak tertutup kemungkinan adanya perubahan atas kebijakan yang dikeluarkan  oleh Pemerintah sehubungan dengan pengenaan PE ini. Di samping itu, pengenaan pajak impor  untuk barang-barang kebutuhan industri perkebunan kelapa sawit berupa kendaraan, alat berat,  peralatan, suku cadang, pupuk, dan lain-lain, dapat meningkatkan beban usaha Perseroan. Untuk  mengatasi masalah tersebut, Perseroan melakukan langkah-langkah efisiensi dan pengelolaan  secara lebih profesional sehingga profitabilitas Perseroan tetap terjaga dengan baik.  The CPO export tax policy is set based on CPO price developments. With the significant increase  in CPO prices and the scarcity of oil in the domestic market, the Government of the Republic of  Indonesia implemented a ban on the export of CPO and its derivatives in mid-2022. Currently,  the CPO export tax is set in accordance with Minister of Finance Regulation (PMK) No. 115/2022 on  Amendments to PMK No. 103/2022 on Service Fees for Public Service Agency BPDPKS at the Ministry  of  Finance which was stipulated and promulgated on 15 July 2022. With the enactment of this  regulation, incentives are applied in the form of temporary elimination of export levies (PE) for CPO  crude palm oil and its derivatives which are managed by the Fund Management Agency Oil Palm  Plantation Fees (BPDPKS) until the end of December 2022. This incentive will apply if the price of  palm oil is still below USD800 per MT, and if the price rises above that, PE will be applied as normally  regulated in PMK. The imposition of CPO export tax can reduce revenue, but the imposition is made  at a relatively high CPO price and if the price drops, the imposition is not imposed, so it does not  disturb the Company's finances too much. However, it is also possible that there will be changes to  policies issued by the Government in connection with the imposition of PE. In addition, the imposition  of import taxes for goods needed by the oil palm plantation industry in the form of vehicles, heavy  equipment, equipment, spare parts, fertilizers, and others, can increase the Company's operating  expenses. To overcome this problem, the Company takes efficiency measures and manages it in a  more professional manner so that the Company's profitability is well maintained.  Risiko kelalaian dan  kegagalan dalam mendapatkan  persetujuan, lisensi, registrasi,  dan izin bisnis Entitas Anak.  Risk of negligence and failure  to obtain approvals, licenses,  registrations, and business  permits for Subsidiaries  Dalam menjalankan usahanya, Entitas Anak dimungkinkan terkendala dalam memperoleh perijinan  usaha dan perijinan lainnya (perpanjangan hak guna usaha (HGU), sertifikasi ISPO, izin lingkungan,  dan perizinan lain) akibat perubahan ketentuan dan peraturan yang berlaku dan berubah sesuai  dengan perkembangan zaman. Perubahan ketentuan dan persyaratan terkait perizinan usaha  dan perizinan lainnya selalu ditanggapi positif oleh Perseroan, karena terkait dengan tuntutan dan  perkembangan zaman, dan juga merupakan bagian dari upaya Perseroan dan Entitas Anak untuk  menjalin hubungan yang harmonis dengan seluruh pemangku kepentingan, termasuk koperasi  petani plasma dan masyarakat sekitar, sehingga perubahan ketentuan dan persyaratan tersebut  selalu ditanggapi secara proaktif dan berusaha memenuhi seluruh ketentuan dan persyaratan  yang diperlukan dengan baik. Dengan kondisi tersebut diharapkan tercipta kondisi yang harmonis  yang memungkinkan Perseroan dan Entitas Anak terus tumbuh dan berkembang dengan baik.  In carrying out its business, Subsidiaries may face problems in obtaining business permits and  other licenses (extension of usufructuary rights (HGU), ISPO certification, environmental permits  and other licenses) due to changes in the applicable terms and regulations and change according  to the times. Perseroan bersikap proaktif dan berusaha mengikuti seluruh  ketentuan terkait lingkungan hidup, sejalan dengan misi perusahaan yang senantiasa berkomitmen  terhadap seluruh pemangku kepentingan dan lingkungan hidup secara berkelanjutan.  Government  regulations  and  policies  related  to  environmental  management  have  developed  following developments in science and global policies related to greenhouse emissions, climate  change  and  deforestation.  The  company  is  proactive  and  tries  to  comply  with  all  provisions  related to the environment, in line with the company's mission which is always committed to all  stakeholders and the environment in a sustainable manner.  Risiko terkait moratorium izin  pembukaan lahan baru.  Risks related to the moratorium  on new land clearing permits.  Moratorium  pemberian  izin  kelapa  sawit  merupakan  salah  satu  isu  global  terkait  dengan  deforestasi  yang  menjadi  perhatian  seluruh  negara  di  dunia,  termasuk  Indonesia.  Walaupun  berpotensi  mempengaruhi  rencana  pertumbuhan  Perseroan,  namun  moratorium  ini  dapat  memperbaiki  keseimbangan  supply  dan  demand  yang  dapat  memperbaiki  posisi  nilai  tawar  CPO di antara minyak nabati lainnya. Perseroan menanggapi moratorium ini secara positif dan  proaktif dengan meningkatkan efisiensi di berbagai lini, walaupun biaya akuisisi lahan perkebunan  semakin tinggi, Perseroan tetap dapat melakukan akuisisi secara terukur dan  prudent  .  The moratorium on the granting of palm oil permits is one of the global issues related to deforestation  which is of concern to all countries in the world, including Indonesia. Even though it has the potential  to  affect  the  Company's  growth  plans,  this  moratorium  can  improve  the  supply  and  demand  balance which can improve the bargaining value position of CPO among other vegetable oils.  The Company responded positively and proactively to this moratorium by increasing efficiency in  various lines, even though the cost of acquiring plantation land is increasing, the Company can still  make acquisitions in a measured and prudent manner.  Risiko tumpang tindih lahan.  Land overlapping risks.  Risiko  tumpang  tindih  lahan  dimungkinkan  terjadi,  terutama  terkait  dengan  penyempurnaan  harmonisasi peraturan dan kebijakan di bidang pertanahan dan kehutanan antara Pemerintah  Daerah dan Pemerintah Pusat maupun antar instansi. Apabila kondisi seperti ini terjadi, Perseroan  selalu bersikap positif dan proaktif serta berusaha mengikuti seluruh peraturan dan ketentuan  yang  berlaku  dengan  selalu  berkomunikasi  dengan  dinas  dan  instansi  terkait  seperti  Dinas  Perkebunan Provinsi Kalimantan Timur dan Badan Pertanahan Nasional (BPN) Provinsi Kalimantan  Timur, serta instansi lain yang terkait.  The risk of overlapping land is possible, especially related to the improvement of the harmonization  of regulations and policies in the land and forestry sector between the Regional Government and  the Central Government as well as between agencies. If conditions like this occur, the Company  is  always  positive  and  proactive  and  tries  to  comply  with  all  applicable  rules  and  regulations  by  always  communicating  with  relevant  agencies  and  agencies  such  as  the  East  Kalimantan  Provincial Plantation Service and the East Kalimantan Province National Land Agency (BPN), as well  as other agencies that related.  Risiko terkait pembatasan  luas kepemilikan lahan.  Risks related to limiting the  area of land ownership.  Peraturan  Pemerintah  No.  26/2021  menyatakan  bahwa  batas  maksimum  penggunaan  lahan  untuk usaha perkebunan kelapa sawit adalah 100.000 Ha yang berlaku bagi 1 grup perusahaan  perkebunan  secara  nasional.  Namun  demikian,  Pasal  234  PP  No.  26/2021  menyatakan  bahwa  perusahaan perkebunan yang telah menggunakan lahan untuk usaha perkebunan sebelum PP  No. 26/2021 diundangkan, dikecualikan terhadap ketentuan batas luas maksimum sebagaimana  disebutkan  sebelumnya.  Saat  ini  luas  lahan  Perseroan  masih  di  bawah  100.000  Ha.  Namun  demikian, tidak tertutup kemungkinan Perseroan akan meningkatkan penggunaan lahannya lebih  dari 100.000 Ha. Perseroan terus mengikuti perkembangan ketentuan mengenai hal ini.   |

| Jenis Risiko  Risk Type  Mitigasi  Mitigation  Government Regulation No. 26/2021 states that the maximum land use limit for oil palm plantation  businesses is 100,000 Ha which applies to 1 plantation company group nationally. However, Article  234 PP No. 26/2021 states that plantation companies that have used land for plantation businesses  before PP No. 26/2021 is promulgated, exempted from the provisions of the maximum area limit  as previously stated. Currently the Company's land area is still under 100,000 Ha. However, it is  also possible that the Company will increase its land use by more than 100,000 Ha. The Company  continues to follow the development of provisions regarding this matter.  Risiko terkait kebijakan  pengupahan.  Risks related to wage  policy.  Kegiatan  usaha  Perseroan  dan  Entitas  Anak  secara  langsung  dan  tidak  langsung  tergantung  pada aspek pengendalian biaya operasional, termasuk upah karyawan. Kenaikan upah minimum,  secara langsung maupun tidak langsung dapat meningkatkan biaya operasional dan menurunkan  margin keuntungan Perseroan. Dengan perbaikan sarana dan prasarana, dan pelatihan, maka  produktivitas tenaga kerja Perseroan dan Entitas Anak dapat semakin meningkat. Kenaikan upah  minimum hingga saat ini masih dapat ditolerir Perseroan dan Entitas Anak.  The business activities of the Company and Subsidiaries directly and indirectly depend on aspects  of controlling operational costs, including employee wages. An increase in the minimum wage,  directly or indirectly, can increase operational costs and reduce the Company's profit margins. With  the improvement of facilities and infrastructure, and training, the productivity of the Company's  and its Subsidiaries' workforce can increase. The increase in the minimum wage until now has been  tolerated by the Company and its Subsidiaries.  Risiko atas adanya  negative  campaign  .  Risk of negative campaign.  Kampanye negatif banyak dilakukan di Amerika Serikat dan Eropa, terutama terkait dengan isu  deforestasi, lingkungan, dan kesehatan. Di luar isu tersebut, juga terdapat persaingan dagang  antara CPO dan minyak nabati lainnya yang diproduksi di Amerika Serikat dan Uni Eropa. Perseroan  tetap fokus menjalankan kegiatan usahanya sesuai dengan prinsip-prinsip yang berlaku dalam  ISPO, yaitu tetap memperhatikan kelestarian lingkungan. Dengan keunggulan yang dimiliki kelapa  sawit, khususnya produktivitas yang tinggi (5-7 ton CPO/Ha), maka  negative campaign  tidak terlalu  berpengaruh terhadap posisi CPO sebagai salah satu sumber minyak nabati dunia.  Many negative  campaigns  have  been  carried  out  in  the  United  States  and  Europe,  especially  related to deforestation, environment and health issues. Apart from this issue, there is also trade  competition between CPO and other vegetable oils produced in the United States and the European  Union. The Company remains focused on carrying out its business activities in accordance with  the applicable principles of ISPO, namely by paying attention to environmental sustainability. With  the advantages possessed by oil palm, especially its high productivity (5-7 tonnes of CPO/Ha),  the negative campaign will not significantly affect CPO's position as one of the world's sources of  vegetable oil.  Risiko atas persaingan usaha.  Risk on business competition.  Persaingan  usaha  di  antara  perusahaan  kelapa  sawit  di  Indonesia  tidak  terlalu  berpengaruh  terhadap  pendapatan  dan  biaya  usaha  Perseroan.  Sebagai  produk  yang  diperdagangkan  secara global, persaingan usaha terutama berasal dari produsen minyak nabati lainnya, seperti  rapeseed, sunflower seed, soybean  ,  dan  peanut  .  Kelapa sawit dinilai memiliki keunggulan yang  tinggi khususnya dari sisi produktivitas dan posisi geografis Indonesia sebagai negara tropis yang  memiliki keuntungan yaitu matahari yang bersinar sepanjang tahun.  Business competition among palm oil companies in Indonesia does not significantly affect the  Company's income and operating expenses. As a globally traded product, business competition  mainly comes from other vegetable oil producers, such as rapeseed, sunflower seed, soybean  and peanut. Palm oil is considered to have high advantages, especially in terms of productivity  and Indonesia's geographical position as a tropical country which has the advantage of the sun  shining all year round.  Risiko perubahan harga dan  pasokan bahan baku.  Risk of changes in price and  supply of raw materials.  Perubahan harga dan pasokan bahan baku merupakan salah satu faktor risiko yang penting  dalam perkebunan kelapa sawit. Ketersediaan bahan baku pupuk, bahan bakar, kendaraan, alat  berat,  peralatan,  dan  suku  cadang  dengan  harga  yang  terjangkau  merupakan  modal  utama  perkebunan kelapa sawit. Kenaikan harga bahan baku secara langsung maupun tidak langsung  meningkatkan biaya produksi produk kelapa sawit. Fluktuasi harga jual produk kelapa sawit pada  tahun 2022 terkait kelangkaan minyak goreng dalam negeri dan perang yang terjadi di Ukraina  juga mempengaruhi  cashflow  Perseroan dan Entitas Anak. Namun demikian dengan melakukan  efisiensi, meningkatkan produktivitas, dan menerapkan manajemen  cashflow  yang konservatif,  fluktuasi  harga  produk  kelapa  sawit  maupun  fluktuasi  harga  bahan  baku  tidak  mengganggu  kinerja operasional dan kinerja finansial Perseroan.  Changes in price and supply of raw materials are one of the important risk factors in oil palm  plantations. The availability of raw materials for fertilizers,  fuel,  vehicles,  heavy  equipment,  equipment  and spare parts at affordable prices is the main capital of oil palm plantations. The increase in raw  material prices directly or indirectly increases the cost of producing palm oil products. Fluctuations  in the selling price of palm oil products in 2022 related to the scarcity of domestic cooking oil and  the war that occurred in Ukraine also affected the cash flow of the Company and its Subsidiaries.  However,  by  implementing  efficiency,  increasing  productivity,  and  implementing  conservative  cash flow management, fluctuations in the prices of palm products and raw material prices do not  interfere with the Company's operational and financial performance.   |
